visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women sit across a table under a glass-roofed porch, facing each other. They engage in an energetic rock-paper-scissors game. The woman on the right wears a white lace headband and a black top; the one on the left is in a dark jacket. A bowl of round, light-yellow snacks sits on a cardboard box. (2) After losing the hand, the woman on the left jumps up and runs out toward the sunny street. The winner remains seated, smiling broadly with her mouth open, and picks up snacks from the bowl to eat. The background shows a sunny street with a parked pink car and brick walls. (3) The runner returns to the table, her face flushed and smiling, and they immediately initiate another round of rock-paper-scissors. They both use rapid, energetic hand gestures, their eyes fixed on each other's hands, while laughing and moving their bodies rhythmically. (4) One woman runs out again while the other continues eating the snacks. In the distant background, a man on a blue electric scooter passes by. The running woman appears to trip and fall flat on the pavement in the distance as the video abruptly ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female voices chant '剪刀石頭布' in unison with extremely high arousal. A fast-tempo, upbeat electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat and bright synthesizer leads kicks in immediately, filling the spectral range with high-energy activity and rhythmic intensity. (2) A rapid sequence of percussive thuds representing running footsteps follows. Sharp, high-frequency crunching sounds occur as a snack is eaten. Continuous loud female laughter and high-pitched giggling are layered over the driving BGM, which maintains a consistent volume throughout. (3) The synchronized vocal chant '剪刀石頭布' repeats with the same high-energy, sharp pitch and sharp, syncopated delivery. The upbeat BGM maintains its steady tempo and bright synth-heavy texture, providing a continuous energetic layer that underscores the rapid interaction. (4) More rhythmic, percussive footstep sounds indicate the runner moving away again. A low-frequency hum of a passing electric scooter engine is heard briefly in the background. A final percussive thud and an exaggerated comedic vocalization signify a fall, followed by fading laughter.

The intent is to entertain through a high-energy, repetitive game loop where the loser must perform a physical task of running while the winner enjoys a snack, concluding with a classic comedic physical fall.
